images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/tropico.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A blocky orange with a leaf on its stalk, drawn as a small icon.
images.replaces: public/images/card-item-1.png, the original's icon on the services cards, whose source the original does not record.
